Sub: Vacancies at National Institute of Pharmaceutical Education and

Respected Sir/Madam
It is to inform you that online applications are invited for the recruitment of various
posts at NIPER. (Source: Employment News 21 to 27- Nov, 2026).
The last date for online submission is 14-Dec-2026
Students & alumni of IKGPTU campuses & affiliated colleges may please be informed to
visit the following link to view the detailed advertisement-
https:/lniperahm.ac.in/career/
You are requested to kindly direct the Training & Placement Officer(s)/ Faculty
Coordinator(s) of your college/ campus to share the information with the students &
alumni, so that they may take the benefit of this opportunity.
With profound regards,
